Home-share in Burnaby 🔑

READING · READ FOR MAIN IDEAS

Francisco’s emails: what does he ask about?

F
1 · WEDNESDAY, JUNE 7THDear Mr. Redmond,
This email is about your home-share in Burnaby. Where is it? Is it big? How many bathrooms are in the house?
Thank you,
Francisco Lopes
J
2 · FRIDAY, JUNE 9THDear Mr. Lopes,
The house is on Grafton Street in Burnaby. It’s very big, with two bathrooms. One bathroom is next to the kitchen and one bathroom is next to the bedroom in my ad. Are you a student?
Sincerely,
John Redmond
F
3 · SATURDAY, JUNE 10THDear Mr. Redmond,
Thanks for your email. Yes, I’m a student. How many people live in the house? Who are they? How old are they?
Thank you,
Francisco
J
4 · SUNDAY, JUNE 11THDear Mr. Lopes,
Four people live in the house now. Two are students. They are 20 and 22 years old. Two are not students. Mr. Johnson is 36 years old, and Mrs. Smith is 71. She is my wife’s mother.
Sincerely,
John
